key_insight: MonteRET is a region-aware retrieval-enhanced AI system that improves chest CT finding-section generation by combining global CT understanding, localized anatomical reasoning, and knowledge-guided report rewriting.
clinical_relevance: It may help produce more complete and clinically faithful CT reports, especially by reducing missed findings and supporting radiologist workflow.
method: Trains on 24,128 chest CT scans from RadGenome-ChestCT.
Uses global CT features plus region-level anatomical representations.
Retrieves relevant knowledge from predicted conditions and vision-language alignment, then rewrites the draft report with an agent.
evidence_signal: The model was evaluated on 1,564 public test CTs and 82 external CTs, with performance improvements over baselines and state-of-the-art methods, plus radiology resident preference.
watch_item: As a retrospective report-generation system, real-world utility will depend on robust external validation, safe integration into clinical workflows, and careful checking for hallucinated or missed findings.
paper_title: MonteRET: AI Agent Enhancing Multimodal LLMs with Multi-granularity Knowledge Retrieval for Chest CT Report Generation
